caption: The drawing features an object that appears to be a mechanical weighing scale set against a plain, cream-colored background. The scale consists of several interconnected metal parts, primarily painted in shades of brown, gray, and metallic blue, with darker shading to indicate contours and metallic sheen. At the upper left, there is a wide, bell-shaped component attached to a horizontal rod. A curved metal hook extends upward from this component, and attached to the lower part are two elongated, jointed arms that hold two different curved hooks—the first hook on the left and a second one directly below it. Suspended from the lower hook is a brown, irregularly shaped weight, with slight orange and yellow highlights suggesting rust or patina. To the right, a long, straight metallic rod extends horizontally, with faint numerical markings visible along its length. The entire apparatus is rendered in a realistic manner, with the objects centrally positioned and contained within a thinly outlined rectangular border.
title: Scales
